note: L = extent of the largest W3c dorsal region along its own principal axis (least spread of L / clicked base: IQR of log 0.186 against 0.208 for the body / chart axis; L = 1.21 clicked bases, median). Centre = the region's centroid. Wide: smallest k in 0.1 steps that holds the whole clicked triangle with a margin of 10 % of the side on every edge in >= 95 % of the 196 clicked fins (95th percentile 1.98). Tight: the region plus 0.15 L on each side (1.3 L), the fin + hump with little else. No region: the parts_up cut-out. Fixed before any validation-day identity score was read.
chosen_on: clicked fins of 2025-01-02 and 2025-03-18 (training days), geometry only, W3c seed 0

centre_variants.note:
The centre alone (follow-up 2026-11-18 pm): the parts_up fin cut-out with its own turn, mirror AND scale, only the
centre changed by the W3c dorsal region. Two variants, fixed in RESULTS/rule.json ("centre_variants") before any
validation score:
  centre   the square's centre moved to the region's centroid, then cluster.parts.frame_inside(..., "fit") as parts_up
           (the square is shifted back inside the photo; the scale is parts_up's, which already fits).
  nudge    parts_up unchanged when its square holds the whole region (its extent along the chart's axes) with a 5 %
           margin of the side on every edge; else the smallest shift per chart axis that brings it inside (a region
           too large for the margin is centred on that axis), then frame_inside(..., "fit") as above.
centre_variants.fixed: 2026-11-18 pm, before any validation-day score of these variants
